{"kind":"lesson","source":"approval-session-2026-10-08","title":"Execute gate must receive the stored approvals","lesson":"runExecute passed an empty approvals array to the gate, so provisional-band actions with a valid approval re-blocked at execute. Forward the task's approvals to every execute-stage gate call.","evidence":"deploy etag 0858ea55; t_bd06, t_39e5, t_4c60 reached terminal:succeeded after the fix","enforced_in":"routes-jev.js runExecute"}

{"kind":"lesson","source":"approval-session-2026-10-08","title":"A pre-send block must not mark the action unknown","lesson":"A dispatch blocked before any provider call (band_provisional, bad_model_route, target_unresolvable, target_payload_invalid) was recorded as dispatched and then verified unknown. Blocked before send means the action stays proposed.","evidence":"pre-fix events on t_4c60 and t_39e5: dispatch_blocked then verify unknown","enforced_in":"routes-jev.js runExecute skip branch"}

{"kind":"lesson","source":"approval-session-2026-10-08","title":"Provisional-band dispatch needs an approved action state","lesson":"The dispatch layer requires action.state approved for provisional bands and nothing wrote that state, so an approval could never unblock a provisional action. Only a fresh bound approval (gate returns approval_id) may mark the in-memory copy approved; nothing is persisted there.","evidence":"dispatch_blocked band_provisional events after approval_granted on all 8 approvals","enforced_in":"routes-jev.js aDispatch"}

{"kind":"lesson","source":"approval-session-2026-10-08","title":"Reconcile evidence must match the event log","lesson":"Five corpus_audit reconciles were written with the generic detail 'dispatch blocked before any provider call', but their events show automation dispatches. Copy observed and detail from the task's own events, never a generic reason.","evidence":"t_fe97, t_dfe5, t_9309, t_9437, t_33c3 reconcile records","enforced_in":"procedure; no code yet"}

{"kind":"lesson","source":"approval-session-2026-10-08","title":"Automation builtins take precedence over endpoint dispatch","lesson":"corpus_audit is an automation builtin, so dispatchRouteAction takes the automation branch ahead of the endpoint branch. Its verdict depends on an automation run task that never settles, so it verifies unknown. A tool verdict must come from a response the caller sees.","evidence":"jev-execute.js branch (a) before branch (c); verify evidence dispatch_response null on the five tasks","enforced_in":"open: verify basis rule"}

{"kind":"lesson","source":"approval-session-2026-10-08","title":"Corpus audit endpoint needs a matrix, not a text prompt","lesson":"POST /api/jev/corpus/audit requires a numeric matrix and rejects a text prompt (INVALID_MATRIX). Text prompts for corpus tools should route through the router endpoint with a loop guard, where guard depth at or above 1 returns measured-only and creates no task.","evidence":"live probe INVALID_MATRIX; policy v15 endpoint_map corpus_audit -> POST /api/jev/corpus/audit","enforced_in":"open: router_with_guard"}

{"kind":"lesson","source":"approval-session-2026-10-08","title":"A verified result must name its basis","lesson":"A router echo is not an audit run, and a cached router answer is not a fresh decision. A verify record must say what it verified against, so a green state cannot hide that nothing ran.","evidence":"router_with_guard design decision 2026-10-08","enforced_in":"open"}
